name: Scriv
description: An inkling created at the Forum of Amity to enforce a diplomatic agreement and who now monitors its contracts and treaties.

timeline.summary: Scriv is created at the Forum of Amity to enforce a delicate diplomatic agreement and takes over monitoring its other contracts.
timeline.quote: Scriv is an inkling initially created at the Forum of Amity to moderate and enforce a particularly delicate diplomatic agreement.
